headline: Recover more from suppliers without losing control of what gets sent
capabilities: Triages damage, shortage, quality and pricing claims
Assembles evidence packs and drafts claim notices
Tracks response windows and drafts escalations before value is lost
Evaluates supplier responses to surface unrecovered value
outcomes: More value recovered: every open claim and its value in one queue
Faster filing: evidence packs arrive as ready drafts
Fewer missed deadlines: at-risk claims surface early
why_try: The demo lets a supplier claims coordinator ask a natural question and receive a source-backed, reviewable answer with the approval boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Supplier Claims Coordinator: Supplier claims queue
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me our open supplier claims and what needs attention today.
